title: Shipping times
content: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days within the country. Express shipping (paid) takes 1-2 business days. International orders take 7-14 business days depending on customs.

title: Return policy
content: Items can be returned within 30 days of purchase if unused and in original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item. Sale items are final sale and cannot be returned.

title: Damaged, defective, or expired products
content: All LookinGood products are guaranteed to arrive in good condition. If an item arrives damaged, broken, leaking, defective, or past its expiry date, contact support within 30 days of purchase with a photo of the product and your order number, and we will send a free replacement or issue a full refund. Damage that happens after delivery is not covered, including products that were dropped or exposed to heat, direct sunlight, or water (for example, left in a hot car or a steamy bathroom). There is no separate long-term warranty: unopened products are best used within 24 months, and opened products within the period shown by the open-jar symbol on the packaging (usually 6-12 months).

title: Tracking an order
content: Once an order ships, a tracking link is emailed to the address on the account. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to activate after the shipping confirmation email.

title: Changing or cancelling an order
content: Orders can be changed or cancelled within 1 hour of placing them by contacting support. After that window, the order has usually entered fulfillment and cannot be changed; a return can be requested once it arrives instead.

title: Account and password help
content: Passwords can be reset from the login page using the 'Forgot password' link. If the account email is no longer accessible, this must be handled by a support agent, not self-service.

title: Skin reactions and allergies
content: If a product causes irritation, redness, a rash, or any other skin reaction, stop using it immediately and rinse the area with cool water. Full ingredient lists are on every product page, and we recommend a patch test before first use. As an exception to the standard return policy, a product that caused a skin reaction can be returned for a full refund within 30 days of purchase even if it has been opened. If the reaction is severe, such as swelling of the face, lips, or eyes, or difficulty breathing, seek medical attention immediately; support will escalate severe reactions to a specialist team.

title: About LookinGood: website and contact
content: LookinGood is a cosmetics brand selling makeup and skincare: lip products, face makeup (foundation, concealer, powder, bronzer, blush, setting spray), eye makeup (mascara, eyeliner, eyeshadow, brow pencils), skincare (cleanser, toner, serum, moisturizer, sunscreen, eye cream) and makeup brushes. The full range, with prices and ingredient lists, is on our website: https://www.lookingood.example.com. This chat assistant is available 24/7. Requests that need a team member are handled Monday to Friday, 9:00-18:00, and you can also reach the support team by email at support@lookingood.example.com.
